sql:
SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(P.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS Average_Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.`T-CHO` >= 250
